review:
DuelReels horror on 5x4 – with a duel against Death himself. VS symbols expand into wild reels showing one of five monsters, and the winner's multiplier covers the reel.

Spell the game's word with low symbols across a row and Death expands over reels 2 to 4. You duel him with three lives and a starting 5x multiplier: win and it grows, lose and you drop a life. A great twist on DuelReels. Rated high, 15,000x max, top RTP 96.34%.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Casinos can run versions as low as 86.28% RTP
